answer: To admit a key, three orchard members with no shared funding history must each pledge basalt behind it. Grove auditors link keys whose wallets and traffic trace to one operator. Each sponsor of a cluster's nth admission then forfeits 50n basalt. A lone agent's sponsors risk 50 basalt each. To field 100 clones, an operator must bribe 300 unrelated orchard members to accept forfeits totalling 757,500 basalt.
